limitations: Cash-proxy history tests structure, not historical X-Perp fills.
The historical universe has ten equities and only eight before MU.
Session gaps terminate the position instead of carrying overnight.
Gross returns exclude fees at user request.

protocol.economic_gate: +30% over 22 market days; 1.327709% constant signed price move per trade at 3% margin, 10x and 3 trades/day
protocol.entry: next 15m market open after a fully closed signal bar
protocol.hypothesis: reverse the stock return minus the simultaneous universe mean; direction and cross-sectional z-score use the same residual
protocol.portfolio: two per scan, four same-direction open, four rolling-hour, three-hour symbol/direction cooldown, pause after two losses
protocol.selection: development only; later eras revealed sequentially
